title: How broad is the loss?

doesNotKnow: The modeled record marks one loss in A and multiple losses across groups in B. This illustrates breadth, not the criteria for naming a real mass extinction: rates, extent and dating require separate evidence.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: In a toy record, one species disappears in case A; many groups disappear in case B over the stated interval. Which case is the broader loss?

claims.text: In a toy record, one species disappears in case A; many groups disappear in case B over the stated interval. Which case is the broader loss? The modeled record marks one loss in A and multiple losses across groups in B. This illustrates breadth, not the criteria for naming a real mass extinction: rates, extent and dating require separate evidence. A: one loss. B: many losses
